correctness.rationale: For weighted path 0-1-2-3, a,1,b, absorb 0 start 1, u=a/(1+a), w=u/(1+b), the complete first-hit law is Bernoulli atom at 1 followed by a geometric time with parameter w on odd later times. The conditional Bernoulli/geometric Fisher tensor is diagonal diag(1/[u(1-u)],(1-u)/[w²(1-w)]), determinant 1/[uw²(1-w)]>0. Coordinates x=2arcsin√u and y=log[(1-√(1-w))/(1+√(1-w))] give dx²+cos²(x/2)dy² and curvature -f/f=1/4. Independently checked the a=b=1 Jacobian pullback equals [[5/12,-1/6],[-1/6,1/6]]. Three-vertex path has ≤1 independent weight ratio; triangle full-law factorizes as independent geometric stopping count and Bernoulli parity, producing a flat 2D product metric. Therefore minimum four vertices is justified.
